requirements.text: Lets name it 'PII Change request'. It will be a Profile Update an manual operation under the HR operations category
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_service WHERE hr_service_id = 55 AND service_name = 'PII Change request' AND fulfillment_type = 'manual' AND topic_detail = 28 AND service_template = 6 AND hr_criteria IS NULL AND active = 1 AND org_id = 1
assumptions: service name spelt as the request gives it, with a lower-case r in request
topic_detail 28 is Profile Update, the only detail of that name, under HR Operations (category 6)
service_template 6, Personal Data Correction Protocol, is the one readymade template for personal data and the only one marked gdpr_compliant, matching 'we need to be GDPR compliant'
fulfillment_type manual is the request's 'manual operation' and is in the policy's list
hr_criteria IS NULL: kept from the benchmark check; not fixed by request or policy
active: kept from the benchmark check; not fixed by request or policy; a case may only reference an active service
org_id 1 is the acting user's org (Robin Monroe, user 31)

requirements.text: Once we have it under HRC0000711, we need to create a task 'PII Change Request', and make it ready to work on it
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_case_task WHERE hr_case_task_id = 150 AND short_description = 'PII Change Request' AND status = 'ready' AND parent_case = 1 AND active = 1 AND org_id = 1 AND assigned_to IS NULL AND assignment_group IS NULL AND task_type IS NULL AND hr_service IS NULL AND external_url IS NULL AND worknotes IS NULL
assumptions: status ready is the request's 'make it ready to work on it', a task status in use on the seed
active: kept from the benchmark check; not fixed by request or policy; a task made ready to work on is active
assigned_to, assignment_group, task_type, hr_service, external_url and worknotes IS NULL: kept from the benchmark check; not fixed by request or policy
org_id 1 is the org of the acting user and of the parent case
the task number is assigned by the server and is not tested

Verify task creation.evidence: number = 'TASK-0001' dropped: the task number is kept by the server, and the seed numbers tasks HRT0001000 to HRT0001148, so the next task would not be TASK-0001; every other cell is kept

notes:
The acting user, Robin Monroe (user 31), has the manager role. The policy reserves creating HR services for administrators and bars managers from system configuration, but the seed's role permissions grant the manager role full access to hr_services and hr_case_tasks, and the request and the benchmark both ask for both records, so both creations are required here; a reviewer may weigh the policy's role text differently.
The policy sets a 30 to 120 character range for short descriptions, but the request names the task 'PII Change Request' (18 characters); the request and the benchmark agree on that text, so it is required as given.
The task is not linked to the new service: the request says only that the task sits under case HRC0000711, so the task's hr_service stays empty as the benchmark check has it. The case itself is not changed by the request, and no listed tool updates cases.
The two passes agree on both requirements and both dispositions; one wrote the empty cells as null values and the other as the predicate IS NULL, the same test, written here as IS NULL. Their texts and assumptions differ in wording only.
